topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Good morrow! It's a fair day for news as bright as the sun that's risen. I heard tell the good lady's house has now passed to her children, both fine folk as can be. A blessed thing, to see the old place in safe hands, the hearth kept warm by those who remember its stories. They say one plans to keep it just as it was, a little piece of the past held close, while the other speaks of changes that might yet bring new life to the old stone. I reckon the saints themselves would smile on such a pair, working together as they must, like seeds sown side by side in the same furrow. May they find as much peace in their days as the old lady found in hers.
